mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE folder_paths AS ( SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.name::TEXT AS path FROM rag_folder d WHERE d.parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, fp.path || '/' || d.name FROM rag_folder d JOIN folder_paths fp ON d.parent_id = fp.id )

s.id AS id, s.file_id AS fileId, s.parent_id AS parentId, f.filename AS fileName, COALESCE(fp.path, '') AS folderPath, CASE WHEN fp.path IS NULL THEN f.filename ELSE fp.path || '/' || f.filename END AS filePath, s.language AS language, s.symbol_type AS symbolType, s.simple_name AS simpleName, s.qualified_name AS qualifiedName, s.signature AS signature, s.start_line AS startLine, s.end_line AS endLine, s.start_column AS startColumn, s.end_column AS endColumn, s.start_offset AS startOffset, s.end_offset AS endOffset

sql.if: AND ( (#{folderId} = 0 AND f.folder_id IS NULL) OR f.folder_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE folder_scope AS ( SELECT d.id FROM rag_folder d WHERE d.id = #{folderId} UNION ALL SELECT d.id FROM rag_folder d JOIN folder_scope fs ON d.parent_id = fs.id ) SELECT id FROM folder_scope ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM rag_code_symbol s JOIN rag_file f ON f.id = s.file_id LEFT JOIN folder_paths fp ON fp.id = f.folder_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( LOWER(s.simple_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{query}) || '%' OR LOWER(s.qualified_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{query}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.signature, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{query}) || '%' )
AND s.symbol_type IN ('JAVA_CLASS', 'JAVA_INTERFACE', 'JAVA_ENUM', 'JAVA_RECORD', 'JAVA_ANNOTATION')
AND s.symbol_type IN ('JAVA_METHOD', 'JAVA_CONSTRUCTOR')
AND s.symbol_type IN ('XML_MAPPER', 'XML_SELECT', 'XML_INSERT', 'XML_UPDATE', 'XML_DELETE', 'XML_SQL_FRAGMENT')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(s.qualified_name) = LOWER(#{query}) THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(s.simple_name) = LOWER(#{query}) THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(s.signature, '')) = LOWER(#{query}) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, s.qualified_name, s.start_line LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM rag_code_symbol s JOIN rag_file f ON f.id = s.file_id LEFT JOIN folder_paths fp ON fp.id = f.folder_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM rag_code_symbol s JOIN rag_file f ON f.id = s.file_id LEFT JOIN folder_paths fp ON fp.id = f.folder_id WHERE s.symbol_type IN ('JAVA_CLASS', 'JAVA_INTERFACE', 'JAVA_ENUM', 'JAVA_RECORD', 'JAVA_ANNOTATION') AND ( LOWER(s.qualified_name) = LOWER(#{className}) OR LOWER(s.simple_name) = LOWER(#{className}) OR LOWER(s.qualified_name) LIKE '%.' || LOWER(#{className}) )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(s.qualified_name) = LOWER(#{className}) THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(s.simple_name) = LOWER(#{className}) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.qualified_name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM rag_code_symbol s JOIN rag_file f ON f.id = s.file_id LEFT JOIN folder_paths fp ON fp.id = f.folder_id LEFT JOIN rag_code_symbol owner ON owner.id = s.parent_id WHERE s.symbol_type IN ('JAVA_METHOD', 'JAVA_CONSTRUCTOR') AND LOWER(s.simple_name) = LOWER(#{methodName})
AND ( LOWER(owner.qualified_name) = LOWER(#{className}) OR LOWER(owner.simple_name) = LOWER(#{className}) OR LOWER(owner.qualified_name) LIKE '%.' || LOWER(#{className}) )
AND LOWER(s.signature) = LOWER(#{signature})
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN LOWER(owner.qualified_name) = LOWER(#{className}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
owner.qualified_name, s.signature, s.start_line LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM rag_code_symbol s JOIN rag_file f ON f.id = s.file_id LEFT JOIN folder_paths fp ON fp.id = f.folder_id LEFT JOIN rag_code_symbol owner ON owner.id = s.parent_id WHERE s.symbol_type IN ('XML_SELECT', 'XML_INSERT', 'XML_UPDATE', 'XML_DELETE', 'XML_SQL_FRAGMENT') AND LOWER(s.simple_name) = LOWER(#{statementId})
AND ( LOWER(owner.qualified_name) = LOWER(#{namespace}) OR LOWER(owner.simple_name) = LOWER(#{namespace}) OR LOWER(owner.qualified_name) LIKE '%.' || LOWER(#{namespace}) )
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN LOWER(owner.qualified_name) = LOWER(#{namespace}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
owner.qualified_name, s.start_line LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM rag_code_symbol s JOIN rag_file f ON f.id = s.file_id LEFT JOIN folder_paths fp ON fp.id = f.folder_id WHERE s.start_line <= #{line} AND s.end_line >= #{line} AND ( LOWER(CASE WHEN fp.path IS NULL THEN f.filename ELSE fp.path || '/' || f.filename END) = LOWER(#{filePath}) OR LOWER(CASE WHEN fp.path IS NULL THEN f.filename ELSE fp.path || '/' || f.filename END) LIKE '%/' || LOWER(#{filePath}) )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(CASE WHEN fp.path IS NULL THEN f.filename ELSE fp.path || '/' || f.filename END) = LOWER(#{filePath}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, (s.end_line - s.start_line), s.start_column DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM rag_code_symbol s JOIN rag_file f ON f.id = s.file_id LEFT JOIN folder_paths fp ON fp.id = f.folder_id WHERE s.file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY s.start_line, s.start_column, (s.end_line - s.start_line) DESC
